Lina (eng-platform): Quick incident note — around 17:34 we had a ~90s onboarding spike that blew through a per-key token bucket and triggered fallback to the smaller model for several canary keys. Observed ~450 reqs/s peak, buckets dropped to 0 and stayed there for ~45s.
Ken (eng-runtime): Do we have the exact policy for that key? is it per-org or per-key?
Lina (eng-platform): It's per-key with an org-level cap. the key belongs to a new customer using our SDK autoplay demo. Policy snippet from prod: 
```
rate_limiter:
  mode: token_bucket
  capacity: 200
  refill_rate: 10/s
  burst_window: 60s
  allow_internal_exemptions: false
```
Ken (eng-runtime): Two things: 1) capacity/refill look low for a developer-heavy demo, 2) we don't surface remaining "surge credits" anywhere in Console today — ops can't tell why a key is throttled without digging into metrics.
Sam (eng-sre): Agreed. We have the metrics (tokens_remaining, tokens_refilled_total) in TSDB but not on the per-key dashboard. Would help to show a simple "credits remaining" and last-refill time.
Alyssa (product): For the Console UX — customers will panic if they see "credits: 0" with no context. Can we show: credits, refill rate, and a tooltip "short-term buffer for spikes" + a small history sparkline?
Ken (eng-runtime): Also propose an internal-only short exemption toggle for canary/test keys with TTL and audit log. Example API: `POST /internal/keys/:id/surge_exemptions` body `{ttl_seconds: 300, reason: "canary"}`. It shouldn't be general available to customers.
Lina (eng-platform): That matches my thinking. Implementation note: exemptions should not bypass billing; they just bypass enforcement for N seconds. Also they must be rate-limited by scope so abuse isn't possible.
Sam (eng-sre): Telemetry ask: emit a "surge_exemption_used" event and a token_debt gauge per key. We need alert rule: if token_debt > X and exemptions used frequently => product/regression.
Ken (eng-runtime): On the enforcement side, we should tweak short-window behavior: keep steady-state leaky bucket for sustained traffic, and allow a separate micro-burst bucket with its own fast refill to absorb onboarding spikes. Pseudoconfig: 
```
rate_limiter:
  steady:
    type: leaky_bucket
    leak_rate: 5/s
  burst:
    type: token_bucket
    capacity: 120
    refill_rate: 60/s
    window: 30s
```
Sam (eng-sre): We'd need to add telemetry for both buckets (used, refill, capacity) and a connector point in Console to toggle whether a key is eligible for micro-bursts. Default: true for internal/dev keys, false for customer keys.
Alyssa (product): UX proposal: in the key detail page add a small section "Spike behavior" with a single-line explanation and a control: [Allow short bursts ✓] (for self-serve keys) + "Request temporary surge" button for SRE/Support with justification field. Audit trail visible.
Lina (eng-platform): Security note: only allow the request temporary surge via RBAC for support and SRE. must require 2FA for approval if TTL > 5m.
Ken (eng-runtime): Can somebody mock a dashboard tile? I can wire the metrics if we agree on names. Proposed metric names: `rl.burst.tokens_remaining`, `rl.steady.leak_rate`, `rl.token_debt`.
Sam (eng-sre): I'll add those to the export and create a Grafana panel. Also adding an alert: `rate(sum(rl.token_debt) by (org) > 100) for 5m => paging` — tweak threshold after one week.
Lina (eng-platform): Action items:
- Ken: prototype micro-burst + steady config and unit tests (ETA 2d)
- Sam: add metrics + create dashboard panel (ETA 1d)
- Alyssa: mock Console copy and control behavior (ETA 3d)
- Lina: small RBAC + audit design doc (I'll PR today)
infra-bot: deploy trigger: rate-limiter:feature/surge-exemptions -> staging (build 4821) :rocket:
Alyssa (product): :thumbsup: if we can keep customer-facing copy calm.
Ken (eng-runtime): i'll start a branch and tag you all. small question — do we persist exemption state in redis or metadata DB? prefer metadata DB for durability.
Sam (eng-sre): metadata DB for auditability. redis could be used for fast checks but must be backed by DB record.
Lina (eng-platform): ok final call: DB + redis cache. I'll open the PR for console fields after Ken's branch lands. Thanks team.
